text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the cooperation of diverse people—umamusume, fans, staff, the URA...
preparations for the "Grand Live" were well underway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And finally—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: This is the venue for the Grand Live!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's so huuuuuge!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Even so, there are still plenty of areas to refine, but...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'd like to ask the students to observe as well.
To get a sense of scale, and the characteristics of each stage.

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! We need to carry materials for the stalls!
Is anyone free right now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Comiiing!
Falco is on her wa—...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
! No way. I heard you all
have training after this!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Please save your stamina.
Setting up the stage is our job as fans.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Grand Live stage isn't the only place
you all want to stand, is it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
There are wishes you want to fulfill
and gratitude you want to share through a Winning Live
that can't be done in a Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The Stage C crew is free now!
We'll come help right away!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
We fans exist
to cheer you on with everything we have.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: So please, leave this to me.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Instead, please shine with all your might on the stage we prepared for you on the day of the event.
choice_data_list: It means each has their own important job to do.
It means each has their own important job to do.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
…………
……Got it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what shall we do
about the songs we'll sing at the Grand Live?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Just to confirm, should I select a song from my current vocal repertoire?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I have an idea regarding that matter.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
First, I'd like to avoid GⅠ songs.
I want those to be special songs
that you only get to sing when you win.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So for those wishing to perform,
we plan to ask for their solo or group preferences
and create dedicated songs for each.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'll make one for everyone.
I've already spoken with the composer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Because it's a concert where everyone sings for themselves. You'd want to put your heart into it, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: And so, regarding that matter, I leave it in your capable hands, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So? Secrets aren't good.
What exactly is this favor you were asked to do?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Could you help those girls
come up with lyrics for this song?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This is an arrangement of a certain song,
crafted to be worthy of the Grand Live.
choice_data_list: Then let's invite Light Hello along too...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...No. I'm just here to watch over you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"I want all of you who are running right now
to write the lyrics for this song."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Please, aim it toward us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the bus, I played the song that Light Hello had handed me back then.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What a lovely song...
choice_data_list: Let's all think about it together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
New mission added.
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on the bus back to the academy,
I racked my brain over the lyrics with them.
